documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Annual General Meeting - Annual Report 2025-2026 Including Notice Of AGM.

analysis.summary: Bizotic Commercial Limited reported strong financial performance for the financial year 2025-26, with sales increasing by 124.02% to Rs. 25,078.65 Lakhs and net profit rising by 322.02% to Rs. 1,808.87 Lakhs. Management highlighted the continued expansion and performance of their retail outlets and fabric wholesale business, alongside capital raising initiatives through preferential warrants and proposed bonus equity shares. The company remains focused on retail expansion, product innovation, and supply chain optimization to capture growth in India's retail and textile sectors.

guidance.claim: Management expressed hope to achieve better results in the next financial year.
guidance.quote: We hope that we will be able to achieve better results in the next financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that India's retail and textile sectors continue to offer tremendous growth potential.
demand_outlook.quote: India's retail and textile sectors continue to offer tremendous growth potential, and we are well positioned to capitalize on these opportunities through continued investments in retail expansion, product innovation, technology, supply chain optimization, and brand development.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that revenue growth was driven by strong performance across key business segments and sustained customer demand despite a challenging market environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite a challenging market environment, we recorded a significant improvement in revenue compared to the previous year, driven by strong performance across key business segments and sustained customer demand.

capex_expansion.claim: The company operates 16 retail outlets across the country and opened a newly developed large-format YARD store in Ahmedabad.
capex_expansion.quote: Today, we proudly operate 16 retail outlets across the country, serving customers with fashionable, premium-quality garments at affordable prices. Our newly developed large-format YARD store in Ahmedabad further reinforces our commitment to delivering an elevated shopping experience while expanding our retail footprint.

capex_expansion.claim: Management noted that the company opened a new store of 16,000 Sq.ft in Ahmedabad under the brand name YARD.
capex_expansion.quote: Company also open new store of 16,000 Sq.ft in the Ahmedabad with the brand name YARD.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates with 25+ retail wear outlets across India.
orders_capacity.quote: With 25+ retail wear outlets across India, we are proud to serve the modern gentleman with a seamless shopping experience that combines style, quality, and affordability.

capital_allocation.claim: The company strengthened its capital base through the issuance of preferential warrants to fund expansion initiatives, operations, and working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Company strengthened its capital base through the issuance of preferential warrants. The proceeds from the preferential issue will support the Company's growth strategy by funding expansion initiatives, strengthening operations, improving working capital, and pursuing new business opportunities.

capital_allocation.claim: The directors did not recommend any dividend for the year with a view to expanding the business.
capital_allocation.quote: With a view to expanding the business, your directors do not recommend any dividend for the year.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended the issue of bonus equity shares in the ratio of 5 new fully paid-up equity shares for every 1 existing fully paid-up equity share.
capital_allocation.quote: The Chairman informed the members that Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on Thursday, 2nd July, 2026, had recommended the issue of Bonus Equity Shares in the ratio of 5 (Five) new fully paid-up equity shares of Rs. 10.00/- each for every 1 (One) existing fully paid-up equity share of Rs. 10.00/- each held, to the members of the Company whose names appear in the Register of Members / List of Beneficial Owners as provided by the Depositories as on the Record Date to be determined by the Board.

capital_allocation.claim: The company proposed increasing its authorized equity share capital from Rs. 9,00,00,000 to Rs. 11,27,00,000.
capital_allocation.quote: the consent of the members be and is hereby accorded to increase the Authorised Equity Share Capital of the Company from the existing Rs. 9,00,00,000 (Rupees Nine Crores Only), divided into 90,00,000 (Ninety Lakhs) Equity Shares of Rs. 10.00/- (Rupees Ten Only) each to Rs. 11,27,00,000/- (Rupees Eleven Crores Twenty-Seven Lakhs Only), divided into 1,12,70,000 (One Crore Twelve Lakhs Seventy Thousand) Equity Shares of Rs. 10.00/- (Rupees Ten Only) each ranking pari passu in all respect with the Existing Shares of the Company.

capital_allocation.claim: The board approved raising up to Rs. 22,27,20,000 through a preferential issue of up to 7,68,000 equity shares at Rs. 290 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: approved raising of funds up to Rs. 22,27,20,000/- (Rupees Twenty-Two Crores Twenty-Seven Lakhs Twenty Thousand only) by way of issuance of up to 7,68,000 (Seven Lakhs Sixty-Eight Thousand) fully paid-up equity shares of the Company of face value of Rs.10.00/- each, (“Equity Shares”) at a price of Rs. 290.00/- (Rupees Two Hundred Ninety only) per share, including securities premium of Rs. 280.00/- (Rupees Two Hundred Eighty Only only) per share

capital_allocation.claim: The company intends to use preferential issue proceeds to meet working capital requirements, store set-up and furniture costs, and general corporate purposes.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company intends to utilize the proceeds raised through the Preferential Issue (“Issue Proceeds”) towards the following objects: a. To meet the Working Capital requirements of the Company (hereinafter referred to as “Working Capital requirements”); b. Store Set-up and Furniture Cost; c. Upto 25.00% (twenty-five percent) of the Issue Proceeds will be utilised for general corporate purposes

risks_headwinds.claim: Management referred to a challenging market environment during the year.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite a challenging market environment, we recorded a significant improvement in revenue compared to the previous year, driven by strong performance across key business segments and sustained customer demand.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains committed to delivering sustainable and profitable growth as they move into the next phase of expansion.
management_commitments.quote: As we move into the next phase of expansion, we remain committed to delivering sustainable and profitable growth.

management_commitments.claim: Convertible warrants are entitled to be converted into equity shares within a period of 18 months from the date of allotment.
management_commitments.quote: entitling the Proposed Allottee(s)/Warrant holders (“Proposed Allottees”) to exercise option to convert and get allotted, in one or more tranches, one Equity Share of Rs. 10.00/- each fully paid-up against each Warrant, within a period of 18 (Eighteen) months from the date of allotment of Warrants

management_commitments.claim: M/s. J. Singh & Associates was appointed as Statutory Auditors for a term of 5 years from F.Y 2024-2025 to F.Y 2028-29.
management_commitments.quote: M/S. J. SINGH & ASSOCIATES CHARTERED ACCOUNTANTS, (FRN: 110266W), be and is hereby appointed as the Statutory Auditors of the Company for a term of 5 (five) years i.e. From F.Y 2024-2025 To F.Y 2028-29

management_commitments.claim: CS Jinang Dineshkumar Shah was appointed as Secretarial Auditor for a period of 5 consecutive years from Financial Year 2025-26 to Financial Year 2029-2030.
management_commitments.quote: CS JINANG DINESHKUMAR SHAH, a Practicing Company Secretaries, Proprietor of M/S JINANG SHAH & ASSOCIATES be and is hereby appointed as Secretarial Auditor of the Company for a period of 5 (five) consecutive years, from Financial Year 2025-26 to Financial Year 2029-2030

management_commitments.claim: Management stated its focus on strategic priorities of innovation, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence looking to the future.
management_commitments.quote: As we look to the future, we remain focused on our strategic priorities of innovation, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence.

management_commitments.claim: Management expressed confidence that continued investment in R&D and commitment to quality will drive growth and success in the years to come.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident that our continued investment in research and development, coupled with our unwavering commitment to quality, will drive our growth and success in the years to come.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
